name: Cache Tools
description: Caching enhancements: sanitize block/view cache tags and contexts, and place precise published-entity cache tags with automatic invalidation.
project_description: Cache Tools adds targeted improvements on top of Drupal's default cache behavior. Its first feature sanitizes (strips) overly generic cache tags and contexts from listed blocks by swapping in a custom block view builder, so blocks stop varying by route/url/query args or busting on node_list/taxonomy_term_list. Its second feature adds precise published-entity cache tags of the form entitytype_entitybundle_pub (e.g. node_article_pub) and optional field-value tags entitytype_entitybundle_pub:field_name:value, placed automatically on views via two ViewsCache plugins and invalidated automatically on entity insert/update/delete via entity hooks. Configuration is entirely through the cache_tools service-container parameter (overridden in a site services.yml), not through the admin UI. Requires the drunomics/service-utils composer library and, at runtime, the core block and views modules.
